Book a consultation

Tell us about your space and choose how you’d like to meet: a studio meeting, a site visit, a video call or a phone call. We’ll confirm a time and recommend the right next step. Any visit or measurement fee is confirmed with you before the visit.

What to prepare

Your project location, property size, a floor plan if you have one, the rooms and services you need, design references, an approximate budget and your timeline.
